premises.statement: The listed matrices are the images, under one well-defined representation of the SAME original G, of the fixed prefix, both complete subgroup bases and two original ambient generators.
The nine original K generators generate the full C_G(a,e), and the nine original H generators generate the full C_G(a,b), for the SAME fixed prefix621.
Every rank-five string C-marking completing this prefix has c in C_G(a,e) and d in C_G(a,b), by its nonadjacent commutations and involution conditions.

Faithfulness of the retained original bridge identifies finite image elements/involutions with the original subgroup elements, if the number60809 is interpreted as the ORIGINAL raw-pair count. The direct common-commutant properness proof itself does not require faithfulness.
